land.text: Iceland, the whole island, as Cliopatria's last Kingdom of Iceland shape (1939)

predecessors.note: 'an agreement with Denmark signed on 1 December 1918 and valid for 25 years' set up the Kingdom; 'The vote was 97% to end the union'. Cliopatria's Kingdom row ends in 1939 and the Republic row starts in 1946, leaving 1940-45 uncovered; the dossier starts at the proclamation of 1944.

correction.text: the whole island of Iceland as a republic from 17 June 1944

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria's Republic row begins in 1946 and its Kingdom row ends in 1939; the page says 'Iceland formally became a republic on 17 June 1944', after a plebiscite begun on 20 May 1944. The British occupation of 1940 ('Operation Fork') and the American takeover of 1941 left the territory Icelandic.

112,115 km2 for 1946-2023 against the infobox 103,125 km2: ratio 1.09, the Cliopatria outline includes coastal waters. The only land change on the pages is the island Surtsey (1963-68), smaller than a grid cell. The 12, 50 and 200 nautical mile fishery limits (1958, 1972, 1975) are sea zones, not land cells.

ledger.note: 17 June 1944: Iceland becomes a republic. 'Iceland formally became a republic on 17 June 1944'; the plebiscite that began on 20 May 1944 voted '97% to end the union' with Denmark.

region.text: Surtsey, off the south coast, which 'rose above the ocean in a series of volcanic eruptions between 8 November 1963 and 5 June 1968'

ledger.note: November 1963: the island of Surtsey rises from the sea. The page gives the eruption span, not an annexation date, and does not give the area; the island is below one grid cell.

wars.name: Cod Wars
wars.outcome: Iceland won each dispute by agreement: 12 nmi (settled February-March 1961), 50 nmi (agreement of 8 November 1973) and 200 nmi (agreement of 1 June 1976); 'Each of the disputes ended with an agreement favourable for Iceland.'
wars.note: The page counts the First Cod War from 1 September 1958 to 11 March 1961, the Second from September 1972 to November 1973, the Third from 16 November 1975 to 1 June 1976, with a 1952-56 precursor over a 3 to 4 nmi limit. The zones are fishery waters, not land, so no zone is listed; belligerent United Kingdom is the dossier united-kingdom (1801..2024, split from Cliopatria's Kingdom of Great Britain row) and West Germany is federal-republic-of-germany (slugs corrected by reviewer eu-22-a).

certainty.note: An island: its coastline is the frontier; the sea limits (12, 50, 200 nmi) are zones of waters, not land.

sources.title: Iceland
sources.note: Identity, Reykjavik, area 103,125 km2, Act of Union 1918, plebiscite 20 May 1944, republic 17 June 1944, Surtsey 1963-68, presidents (only Vigdis and Halla dated).

sources.title: Cod Wars
sources.note: The four disputes 1952-1976, their agreements and the fishery limits.

notes:
Cliopatria row: Republic of Iceland 1946..2024 (2 shapes); the earlier Kingdom of Iceland row (1918..1939) is another dossier (Q62567). Both rows draw the same 458 grid cells (checked), so there is no border change, only a gap: the dossier starts on 17 June 1944 (page) and the new keyframe republic-of-iceland_1944 covers 1944-45. The wartime British and American occupation (1940-45) is a gap in Cliopatria and is not drawn as a change of state: the page gives no date for the British landing and says 'In 1941' only for the American arrival, so no occupation event is written. The page gives only three presidential dates (Sveinn Björnsson 'its first president' in 1944 without an end year; Vigdís Finnbogadóttir 1980-1996; Halla Tómasdóttir from 1 August 2024), not a list, so identity.rulers is omitted rather than left with gaps.

Gazetteer names wanted: Surtsey (63.30 N 20.61 W, below the grid; the region resolves to no cell) and the Westman Islands (Vestmannaeyjar). The end year 2026 is the current year.
